notes.title: Update Released & Massive Sale Alert
notes.content:
Hello Typomaniacs 👻

We're happy to announce that we finally rolled out an update for Typoman on Steam packed with some nice enhancements and fixes!

What's New?

 Full Controller Support of new & old PlayStation, Xbox and compatible controllers
 Wide- and Ultrawidescreen Support and no more UI issues
 Enhanced compatibility for newer Windows releases, no more crashes and smoother gameplay
 Fine-tuned some of the puzzles and removed a few annoying bugs that were on our list for a long time..
 Codebase upgrades and improvements for better game performance and stability
 Updated the Game Icon


To celebrate this and to thank you for your support, we're offering Typoman at 75% off for a limited time. If you already own Typoman - make your friends happy and buy it as a gift! 👌💡

Thank you for being a part of the timeless adventure of our little HERO.

Cheers!

John P. // Brainseed Factory
https://brainseed-factory.com

notes.title: Update Rollout and Open Beta Invitation
notes.content:
Finally our patch is ready. 🕺💃 That pesky launch crash really was something! 😵
A tough nut to crack, but thanks to some incredible support, we believe the crashes are gone for good!

Now extending an invitation to anyone affected by crashes to join our Open Beta and confirm the effectiveness of this patch. 

Ah - we've fixed controller compatibility issues too, so feedback here is also welcome!

To join in Open Beta:
1) Navigate to your Steam Library.
2) Right-click on Typoman and select 'Properties.'
3) Go to the 'Betas' tab.
4) Enter the code “VSVGSB0HBWIW” in the 'Private Betas' field and click “Check Code.”
5) The library title will update to “Typoman [Beta]” and begin downloading the patch.
6) Enjoy and kindly forward any bug reports to mail@typoman.net


We appreciate your help & patience!

Cheers,
John
Brainseed Factory

notes.title: Need Beta Testers for upcoming patch
notes.content:
Hey Fam!
We're back at Typoman after a long pause!

First -  We'd like to deal with the most pressing issue: A vicious launch crash that some of you encountered with newer Windows versions. 

After that -  You can expect us adding a few nice things now that we took the time to clean up our ancient source code. And better Steam Deck support. ːsteamhappyː

We need Beta Testers! 
Specifically people who encountered this vicious launch-crash-bug. To be honest we have never been able to reproduce it ourselves. We tested on various PCs with different Windows versions and configurations, and it never crashed!

Still - I believe we fixed the bug after upgrading the codebase and testing a lot, but we're not very sure. If you have been greeted by crashes after launching the game please email us via mail@typoman.net!

We'd like to give you access to our current beta build. If you have already refunded the game because of the crash please contact us anyway.

Thanks for your support & patience!
John // Brainseed Factory
www.brainseed-factory.com

notes.title: Patch 1.9 with support for Linux + SteamOS and new fixes
notes.content:
The wait is finally over, Typoman now supports Linux and SteamOS! 

In a quick beta test session we were able to locate and remove critical bugs and crashes, so the game will hopefully run very smoothly on most Linux configurations. 

Kudos to everyone who participated, but also to our amazing programmers who were quick to address every issue that was reported!

Get in touch if you're still encountering any problems, we'll make sure to quickly patch them out!

Your Brainseed Factory

notes.title: Typoman: Revised 1.7 - Autumn Update Release Notes
notes.content:
Dear folks - thanks to your much appreciated feedback we can hardly find any more bugs.

- In case you haven't noticed - our last update added Mini Games which will hopefully give you hours of additional Typoman fun, just play through the main game to unlock them
- Halloween is over - no more pumpkins and bats
- Main dictionary & antonym dictionary dramatically improved
- Xbox 360 / One Controller support / fix (Mac OS X)
- HUD / Menu translation added in German, French, Russian, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese
- improved performance on weaker systems, now auto-setting to low quality when weak system is detected
- many other fixes, most notably:
- critical "stuck-in-falling-pose" fixed
- critical "unable-to-pull-lever-or-letters" bug fixed

Give us a shout if you think we missed something.

Happy gaming!

Your 
Brainseed Factory

notes.title: Halloween Update 1.5 adds Mini Games and Original Soundtrack!
notes.content:
Beloved Typoman Fans - you've been asking for more content and here it is, we really hope you will enjoy the new additions as much as we are enjoying them.

Two new game modes form the core of the new update. The first mode, Antonymizer adds 168 new challenges where you have to combine words with antonyms to spell the correct word.

The second mode Word Hunter is a race against the clock in a time-based challenge - form as many words as possible in 60 seconds to top your high score, check menu STATS to see what your global rank is!

The update also improves performance on weaker system configurations and fixes a number of issues that you reported to us!

Let us know what you think!

Your 
Brainseed Factory

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25501945/daca21f91c882b4b26bacb3d6822c58f23b55e3d.jpg

notes.title: Patch 1.3 released
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25501945/d449b2c9792d7a6a62cf16fc15b0223cac2a6f2a.jpg

We've just released a patch with many fixes for issues that we noticed through your much appreciated feedback or while watching some of your awesome Typoman streams and youtube gameplay videos!

Our focus was also to improve performance on weaker systems. If you are seeing things such as your character won't keep grabbing letters or a slight time difference between pressing the jump button and the actual jump, please go to the main menu settings and switch resolution to low, turn off other applications that are running on your system in background.

Most issues could be solved by turning off expensive and memory consuming antivirus software which are set in a mode to scan your system constantly. 

Typoman: Revised - Patch 1.3 Release Notes:
- VSYNC option added
- selectable confirm plate on letter dispensers
- sound effect stereo corrections
- reset of playthrough achievements bug fixed (apologies, happened sometimes when not playing through in one run which was not intended. important note: the first tutorial use of the Wordscambler does not count of course)
- invisible collider removed
- minor background graphics glitches fixed
- missing climb ledge trigger added in chapter 3
- volume reduced for a very loud track in chapter 3
- words added EVADE, AVOID
- more minor fixes and more easter eggs and fun words for you to discover!

Hey you, please give us a thumbs up 
and a positive review on Steam,
we need your help to keep releasing
patches and new content!

THANKS & ENJOY!

Brainseed Factory

notes.title: Update 1.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
- big change for word hunters: all letter dispensers are now much faster
- added confirm button on letter picker interface (you can still use shortcut buttons ENTER / Y / ▲)
- added even more puzzle & fun words to the dictionary (try PIRATE for example)
- fixed sporadic TRUST / TILT puzzle grab bug
- added "Word Found" to bottom left corner
- fixed cam stutter when HERO was healed from fear effect
- fixed some other minor issues

notes.title: Patch 1.1 + Cards now available!
notes.content:
If you are enjoying the game please give it a thumbs up and a positive review on Steam.

We're happy to announce the release of Typoman cards and a first patch

- volume slider added in settings menu
- improved word recognition (new solution words and easter eggs)
- screen selection button added in settings menu
- improving controller compatibility
- fixed cam bug (blue screen)
- fixed rotated cam bug
- fixed COVER + LIE bubble bug
- fixed HOLD bug
- fixed ROTOR scene
- fixed LIAR achievement
- ...and dozens of other small issues

We've seen lots of fan artwork and it makes us so very happy! Please share yours with us on Twitter or Facebook using the #Typoman hashtag.

Follow us on Twitter
Like us on Facebook

More coming soon!

Brainseed Factory

notes.title: Thank you + Patch 1.01 coming this week
notes.content:
WORDS are more powerful than SWORDS. 
Correct!
 I can add one letter to WORDS to transform it to SWORDS. Or just rearrange it to SWORD. 
One letter can change everything!

Thank you all for playing Typoman: Revised and for supporting us with all your great feedback. We are preparing a patch with a fix for dozens of issues that were reported by you to improve the gaming experience even more. No new content coming with this update yet, but there are a couple of issues that will be addressed like:

- Controller compatibility especially in combination with Win 10
- Volume slider - sorry for forgetting this ːsteamfacepalmː
- adding some solution words to dictionary where it makes sense
- performance improvements at some pretty crammed sceneries
- we're adding some awesome Trading cards, Emoticons and Backgrounds... and of course badges!

...and many more!

Let us know if you want us to address anything specific

 Change Words. Change Worlds. 

Brainseed Factory

notes.title: Patch 0.3 RC coming today!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Heroes, beta testers, reviewers - just in case you didn't know - release will be on Monday, August 15th! 
Until then we will release one or two more patches to fix some bugs which are of non-severe type ...so basically just some blemish treatment, squeezing some pimples.

Please know that we will most likely flush leaderboards and achievements to have a clean start, there will be some minor balancing on those too.

Have fun and let us know what you think!
